beats.name: hook
beats.said: Plant a tree beside an empty road and cars will steer right into it.
beats.shown: Man plants tree, it grows fast and knocks him over; car veers toward it.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: The road is dead straight for miles and this one tree stands alone beside it.
beats.shown: Man on grass by tyre; aerial view of straight road with lone tree.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Somebody hits it weekly, so the town adds a flashing arrow, crashes double, tow driver profits.
beats.shown: Days-since-crash sign, giant neon arrow, wrecks, tow truck and lawn chair.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: The sheriff investigates, crawls at 15 mph and still crashes, then axes the tree.
beats.shown: Sheriff in cruiser, speed sign, crash, furious axe chop with lightning, blast to sky.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: His cruiser gets fixed, he drives back for peace, and hits the stump again.
beats.shown: Garage repair, drive back, cruiser hitting stump by the arrow.

beats.name: explainer
beats.said: It is target fixation: the lone tree stands out, the arrow adds to it, drivers' eyes lock on.
beats.shown: Night rain POV of dashboard with road sign, tree glowing in fog, sheriff close-ups.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: Their hands drift the wheel toward it even when it's only a stump.
beats.shown: POV of steering wheel, then wide shot of cruiser hitting the stump under dark sky.

hook.first_frame: Cartoon man in red cap and teal jacket stands on grass beside a road, holding a dark mitt-like object, a dirt mound in front of him.
hook.first_3s: He plants a seed, a huge tree bursts up and knocks him over; camera pulls out to a wide of the road with a car swerving toward the tree.
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title names the effect (instinct that makes you crash); the first line states the tree premise, and the title's concept is only named at 43s.

story.structure: act first, explain at the end
story.real_fact_core: Target fixation: drivers steer toward what they stare at, so a salient lone obstacle draws crashes.
story.protagonist: Tow truck guy and the sheriff (a comic escalation duo)
story.authority_or_antagonist: The sheriff, who repeats the mistake despite knowing.
story.explainer_turn: 'So how does this keep happening?' at 42.07s, then 'target fixation' at 43.7s

tone.humour: Absurd escalation: the fix makes it worse, tow driver profits, sheriff repeats the crash.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Deadpan narration over slapstick; heavy irony in the arrow and the sheriff returning for a quiet road.
tone.dialogue_style: No quoted dialogue; fast narrated present-tense summary, very short sentences.

generation_evidence.observation: Tree growth, leaves and bark stay coherent through the move; clean perspective and consistent geometry.
Zoom into the eye with a vector-clean outline stays sharp, then an iris-mask transition: a compositing effect.
Sheriff face is identical across frames, static mouth, the hat and glasses crisp; the interior details (turtle toy, beer cup) stay stable.
Sign text DAYS SINCE LAST CRASH is crisp and stable and numbers swap cleanly; no warping text.
Tyre rolls with physical bounce and shadow; cap man changes pose, with a hard outline unaffected.
Chop blast and ring explosion look like stylised particle or sim effects with a radial burst.
